sections.heading: Quick Change Orifice (QCO) Nozzles for Counterflow Towers
paragraphs: Shepherd QCO Nozzles offer a diffusion plate designed to provide uniform water dispersion in all directions, as needed in a counterflow tower design. This even flow prevents streaming as the water exits the nozzle and ensures sufficient contact with fill media. The 1.5″ NPT nozzles feature a large diameter opening to preclude the build-up of silt and to allow the passage of cleaning balls. The Shepherd QCO Nozzle combines economy and quality.
